product.name: Smart-T T2 Smart Toilet with Bidet Wash, Heated Seat, Remote Control & Warm Air Dryer - Rimless Close Coupled Water Saving WC
product.description:
The Smart-T T2 is a fully integrated smart toilet designed to transform everyday routines into a more comfortable, hygienic and refined experience. Combining advanced technology with intuitive design, it delivers a level of cleanliness and convenience that goes far beyond a traditional toilet.

At the core of the T2 is its intelligent washing system, featuring both rear and female wash functions alongside oscillating and pulsating massage sprays. With fully adjustable water temperature, pressure and spray position, every use can be tailored to your preference. A self-cleaning nozzle ensures consistent hygiene, while the heated seat and warm air dryer provide a level of comfort you'll quickly come to expect.

Designed with ease of use in mind, the T2 includes a sleek remote control and dual side seat controls for simple, precise operation. The automatic seat opening and soft close functionality add a seamless, hands-free touch, while the integrated night light and intelligent power-saving mode make it perfectly suited for both day and night use.

Performance is matched by efficiency. The water-saving 3.5L rimless washdown flush delivers powerful cleaning with reduced water usage, while the anti-bacterial ceramic glaze helps maintain a cleaner surface with minimal effort. Concealed connections and a clean, modern silhouette ensure the T2 fits effortlessly into both contemporary and traditional bathroom spaces.

Supplied with all essential fittings for installation and backed by a 3-year manufacturer's warranty, the Smart-T T2 offers a complete, future-ready upgrade. It's not just a smarter toilet, it's a smarter way to live.

product.name: Ener-J HygienePro White Smart Toilet with Integrated Tank, Heated Seat, Warm Water Bidet & Dryer
product.description:
Upgrade your bathroom with the Ener-J HygienePro Smart Toilet, an all-in-one design that combines a modern, tankless look with advanced hygiene and comfort technology. The integrated tank removes the need for a separate cistern, giving you a clean, compact profile (680 x 400 x 475 mm) that suits contemporary bathrooms and en-suites. It works with water pressure from just 0.06 MPa, so it performs reliably in most homes.

The built-in bidet heats water instantly as you use it, so there's no waiting and no stored hot water. You can choose from female, hip, massage, moving spray and baby wash modes. Water, seat and dryer temperatures each have four settings (ambient, 34°C, 37°C or 40°C), and the spray position moves forward and backward for a precise, personalised clean. Afterwards, the warm air dryer offers a hands-free, paper-saving finish.

Hygiene is built into every detail. The nozzle cleans itself automatically, UV sterilisation adds extra protection, and the antibacterial seat and anti-fouling ceramic glaze help keep the bowl cleaner for longer. A foam shield reduces splashing, and the dual filtration system protects the water supply.

Control is effortless. You can use voice commands, the included remote, the one-touch side knob or the foot sensors, which open the lid and seat and flush without contact. The automatic lid opens as you approach, and the soft-close seat and lid shut quietly. The power failure flushing function means the toilet still flushes during a power cut.

For extra relaxation, the toilet includes built-in aromatherapy, music playback and 256-colour ambient mood lighting, plus a soft night light for late-night visits. An energy-saving mode and leakage protection add everyday peace of mind.

product.name: LavaTap 110mm Air Admittance Valve  Female Push Fit & Solvent Weld Fitting for Soil Vent Pipes Internal External Use
product.description: Air admittance valves are innovative fittings that eliminate the need for soil pipes to terminate externally, bypassing traditional position requirements. Traditionally, open vent pipes had to be installed at least 900mm above any building openings within 3 meters to prevent foul odors from entering the living space. Air admittance valves solve this by allowing air into the pipework to prevent pressure buildup while ensuring odors remain contained. These valves can be installed anywhere in the above-ground drainage system, as long as they are positioned at least 200mm above the highest wet entry point (the highest point where wastewater enters the system). Available in internal and external types, both must be installed upright. External valves use a push-fit rubber seal for soil pipe connections, while internal valves fit around the pipe's exterior. Both types can also function as secondary rodding points. Known as Durgo valves, they save on labour and material costs and are safer than open vent pipes by eliminating the need for roof-level access during maintenance. Fitted with environmental mesh to allow external installation.  uPVC Construction Push-Fit Connection 30.8Ltr/sec Air Flow Capacity Domestic / Commercial Demountable &amp; Reusable

product.name: Valiant Remora Magnetic Flue Pipe Fan, Moisture Meter and Magnetic Thermometer
product.description: Ideal for Inset Stoves or Stoves with limited clearance, our Remora Stove Fan attaches to your Flue Pipe using the powerful magnetic clamp. It then disperses heat throughout your room ensuring all areas are warm in no time. Available with your choice of Red or Green Thermometer which shows you the ideal temperature to burn your logs. This pack includes a Green Magnetic Thermometer.  The thermometer monitors your stove temperature to optimise performance and protects your stove from overheating. It also clearly displays the temperature of your stove, enabling you to maintain a safe and efficient operating temperature and reduce fuel consumption.  Use the handy Valiant Moisture meter to ensure you get the best burn from your fuel. Our newest model not only has a backlight screen to illuminate the reading but the built-in colour change technology indicates the moisture level of the firewood. It’s an essential tool for any fireplace owner!  Fuel quality is the single most important aspect of making a successful fire. To burn effectively the moisture content of firewood needs to be less than 20%, whether it’s being used in an open fire or a stove. Freshly felled timber can have a moisture content of between 30% and 60%, which when burnt can cause dangerous creosote build-up in chimneys. Using a moisture meter is a great way to check whether your wood will give you a safe and efficient burn, or if it needs further seasoning. The screen will glow green if your fuel contains less than 20% moisture, indicating that it’s ready to go. The new Valiant moisture meter can also be used in timber, floors and buildings in order to detect and measure moisture content.

product.name: Valiant Magnetic Flue Pipe Stove Fan and Thermometer
product.description:
Ideal for Inset Stoves or Stoves with limited clearance, our Remora Stove Fan attaches to your Flue Pipe using the powerful magnetic clamp. It then disperses heat throughout your room ensuring all areas are warm in no time. 

Featuring a powerful magnetic clamp that can withstand temperatures over 400°c, the Remora can quickly and easily attach to almost any Flue Pipe (4-7”) with magnetic attraction.* Once in place, the Stove Fan will automatically kick in as soon as your Flue Pipe warms up. With a starting temperature as low as 50°C, the Remora will soon be distributing warm air silently and effortlessly throughout any living space in which it is situated.

*A very small number of Flue Pipes are made from Stainless Steel and as such will not support the magnetic clamp. Please check your flue pipe attracts magnets prior to ordering the Remora. A simple fridge magnet will identify whether or not your Flue Pipe is sufficiently magnetic.

The set also includes a magnetic thermometer which will help protect your stove from overheating.

The magnetic Thermometer clearly displays the temperature of your stove, enabling you to maintain a safe and efficient operating temperature and reduce fuel consumption.

The robust design and strong magnet of the Stove Thermometer means that it’s suitable for use on any hot steel or iron surface, including stoves, BBQ, range cookers, patio heaters, flue pipes or chimeneas.

product.name: Valiant Remora Magnetic Flue Pipe Fan, Moisture Meter and Magnetic Thermometer
product.description: The Remora is a powerful warm air circulating stove fan that features a strong magnetic clamp to attach to your flue pipe as opposed to sitting on your stove top. This means you can use it with any type of stove, regardless of the shape, size, or temperature of the top surface. It also means you can avoid the risk of damaging your stove fan by placing it too close to the fire. The fan is perfect for stoves that have a cool top, such as gas stoves, pellet stoves, or electric stoves. It can also work with stoves that have an irregular surface, such as cast-iron stoves, or a soapstone or angled top, such as Scandinavian stoves. The magnetic clamp allows you to adjust the position and angle of the fan to suit your flue pipe and optimize the airflow. The Magnetic Stove Thermometer in this pack monitors your stove temperature to optimise performance and protects your stove from overheating. It also clearly displays the temperature of your stove, enabling you to maintain a safe and efficient operating temperature and reduce fuel consumption. Place the Thermometer on the top, front, or side of a flat or curved surface. The built-in magnet will maintain its hold on steel up to temperatures of around 800°F (425°C). The optimum position is on the flue collar, or if not practical, as close to the collar as possible for a stable reliable place for monitoring the stove and flue gas temperature. This thermometer is suitable for use with most vitreous enamel, iron or steel flue pipes. For stainless steel flue applications do not attempt to fix to flue pipe, attach to the stove collar or place on the stove top.

product.name: Pegdev Detectable Mesh (Gas Pipe) Durable Underground Service Marker 200mm x 26m
product.description: Pegdev Detectable Gas Pipe Mesh is designed to provide a clear and highly visible warning for buried underground gas pipes during excavation work. Manufactured from high-strength, rot-resistant yellow HDPE, the mesh features an integrated detectable wire and repeated printed “CAUTION - BURIED GAS PIPE” warning text. The highly visible yellow colour helps identify buried gas pipes when the mesh is exposed during excavation. Designed to be clearly visible when pulled up in an excavator bucket, the mesh provides an obvious warning to groundworkers and excavation teams. The integrated detectable wire allows the mesh to be located from the surface, providing an additional method of identifying underground gas pipe routes before or during groundworks. This durable warning mesh is suitable for contractors, builders, utility companies, landscapers and groundworkers working on construction and excavation projects. The mesh is rot resistant and manufactured from durable HDPE to withstand demanding underground conditions, providing a long-lasting solution for underground service identification. The repeated warning message provides clear visual identification when the mesh is uncovered. Conforms to BS12613:2023 and provides a practical solution for clearly marking buried gas pipe services during construction, excavation and groundworks. product.name: 50Pcs Heavy Duty Self Adhesive Hooks,No-Trace Sticker Frame Hangers Without Nails Adhesive Shower Hooks for Keys,Bathroom, Shower
product.description:
Self‑Adhesive Screw Wall Hooks, 50‑Pack / 100‑Pack
These no‑drill self‑adhesive screw hooks are a perfect hole‑free wall‑mounting solution, eliminating the need for nails or drilling and protecting your walls from permanent damage. Great for renters and homeowners alike.

Product Specifications
‑ Available Pack Size: 50‑Pack, 100‑Pack

‑ Material: Heavy‑duty transparent PET adhesive pad, rust‑proof metal screw, reinforced plastic base

‑ Color: Clear sticker, silver‑toned metal screw

Wide Usage Scenarios
‑ Hang picture frames, photo prints, wall art, posters, wall clocks, decorative signs and gallery wall displays

‑ Mount floating shelves, bathroom racks, kitchen organizers, small wall‑mounted accessories

‑ Suitable for smooth non‑porous surfaces: ceramic tile, glass, marble, smooth finished wood, painted walls, plastic panels

‑ Ideal for apartments, rental homes, dormitories, living rooms, kitchens, bathrooms, offices

Installation Instructions
   

Thoroughly clean and dry the wall surface, remove dust, grease and water stains
   

Peel off the protective backing film
   

Press the transparent adhesive pad firmly onto the wall and squeeze out all air bubbles
   

Apply firm pressure for 30‑60 seconds
   

Wait 24‑48 hours before hanging items to achieve maximum load‑bearing strength
Important Notes

product.name: Thermopanel Corner Square Drain Wet Room Shower Tray Former - 1300 x 900 x 25mm - Gold Sunburst Grate Design and Tanking Kit
product.description: Thermopanel Corner Square Drain Wet Room Shower Tray Former (20/25mm)  The Thermopanel Square Corner Drain Shower Tray Former is the perfect solution for creating a stylish, flush walk-in shower or wet room. Unlike bulky acrylic trays, it provides a seamless, tile-ready base that integrates beautifully with your bathroom floor. Lightweight but exceptionally strong, the tray includes a pre-formed 2% gradient for efficient drainage and is coated with a cementitious layer, ready for tiling with ceramic, porcelain, stone, or mosaics.  Available in both 20mm and 25mm depths, this versatile tray can be trimmed by up to 50mm from each edge (equal cuts required), giving installers complete flexibility. It comes with a Corner-positioned square drain, with a choice of six grate designs – Leaf, Tile, Square, Sunburst, Spiral or Radial – and three finishes: Black, Gold, or Stainless Steel. The Thermopanel system is suitable for timber or concrete floors, works seamlessly with electric underfloor heating, and is supported by a lifetime warranty when fitted according to manufacturer’s instructions.  Key Features:  20mm or 25mm depth options. Square Corner drain with 6 grate designs (Leaf, Tile, Square, Sunburst, Spiral, Radial). Tile On grate is reversible, allowing for either a tile on or a solid grate design. Choice of finishes: Black, Gold, Stainless Steel. Waste included. Pre-made 2% fall ensures fast water flow. Tile-ready surface, suitable for ceramic, porcelain, mosaics & natural stone. Lightweight, strong, and easy to install. Trim up to 50mm from each edge for flexibility. Compatible with electric underfloor heating. Suitable for timber and concrete floors. Backed by a 25 year warranty.

product.name: Shower Seal for Screens, Doors or Panels, Fits 4, 5 or 6mm Glass, Bubble Shape Seals Gaps of Up to 7mm, 80cm Long, SEAL001
product.description:
This shower seal is comprised of a high quality rigid PVC U section designed to comfortably grip any glass ranging from 4mm to 6mm thick with no need for any additional adhesive. The bottom of the seal has a soft flexible bubble which will seal any gap from 3mm to 7mm.

These seals are commonly found on either the bottom horizontal section of a bath screen or shower door, and can also be used vertically on the upright of the glass to create a seal between the glass and the tiles or wall. Please note that this is a straight shower seal designed only for use on straight glass.

This product comes in 800mm, 900mm, 1400mm or 2000mm lengths and can be cut down to size once you’ve received it.

Installation of our seals is nice and easy. Simply push the seal onto the glass from below on one end and work your way along, pushing the seal up onto the glass as you go. Do not try to slide the seals along the glass as this can damage it.

If you're struggling to find the correct seal for your shower/bath screen then please don't hesitate to get in contact with us. We would be more than happy to help.

product.description:

Manufactured from heat-resistant EPDM rubber with a smooth bore inner layer and weather-resistant synthetic rubber outer, it delivers efficient fluid transfer while standing up to heat, ozone, and environmental exposure. product.name: Layflat Discharge Hose Pipe Yellow 51mm ID PVC Polyester Reinforced Submersible Pump Compatible, 4m and 2 Hose Clips
product.description: This bundle combines Hoses UK PVC Layflat Hose with two W4 stainless steel worm drive hose clips, providing a ready-to-use water transfer solution with everything needed to make secure, leak-free connections straight out of the box. The layflat hose features a smooth PVC inner bore reinforced with high-strength polyester yarn, delivering reliable performance at a working pressure of 4 bar across agricultural, construction and industrial pumping applications. Manufactured to ISO 8029:2007, it operates between -10°C and +65°C and lies flat when empty for compact storage and easy deployment. The two included stainless steel worm drive hose clips (DIN 3017, W4 grade, 12 mm band) clamp securely onto the hose ends, ensuring a firm seal on pipes, fittings and spigots. With a 3:1 safety factor and an operating temperature of -60°C to +180°C, the clips are built to last in demanding environments without the need for additional fasteners.

product.name: Flexible Rubber Car Heater Radiator Coolant Hose 19mm Bore 4m SAE J20R3 Steel Wire Reinforced Anti Kink High Temperature
product.description:
This Rubber Wire Reinforced Hose is a heavy-duty industrial hose designed for demanding fluid transfer applications where strength, pressure resistance, and durability are essential. Manufactured with a smooth black synthetic SBR rubber inner layer, it provides reliable flow characteristics and resistance to wear during continuous use. Reinforced with two-ply fabric cords and a steel wire spiral, the hose maintains its shape under suction and pressure, preventing collapse and improving safety during operation.

The outer layer is constructed from smooth black synthetic SBR rubber, offering excellent resistance to abrasion, weathering, and general site conditions. Designed to operate within a temperature range of -20°C to +80°C, with peak resistance up to +85°C, this hose is suitable for industrial, agricultural, and engineering applications where dependable performance is required.

With a working pressure rating of 10 bar and a bursting pressure of 30 bar, the hose delivers consistent performance in both pressure and vacuum systems. Manufactured to SAE J20R3 standard, it is ideal for suction, discharge, fluid transfer, and general-purpose industrial use. Supplied in 20 metre coils, this wire reinforced rubber hose provides a reliable solution for professional users requiring flexibility, strength, and long service life.

product.name: Clear Braided Hose Kit 51mm (2") Bore 4m PVC Tube Plastic Joiner 2 Stainless Steel Clips Reinforced Air Water Irrigation Pipe
product.description: This kit pairs a 4 metre cut length of 51mm internal diameter clear PVC braided hose with the matching 51mm plastic straight joiner and 2 stainless steel worm drive hose clips, so a run can be extended, repaired or joined straight out of the box. The hose is reinforced with triple polyester yarn between soft PVC inner and outer walls, giving stable pressure handling and good kink resistance while staying flexible enough to route around obstacles. The 3.5mm wall supports a working pressure of up to 4 bar with a 3:1 burst safety factor, and the transparent construction lets flow and contents be inspected at a glance. Operating range is -10C to +65C with a +70C peak, and the hose is compliant with ISO 5774:2016 Type A. The barbed joiner pushes into both hose ends and is secured by the two supplied clips for a leak-free connection. Typical uses include pneumatic tools and air lines, water and irrigation feeds, pond and aquarium plumbing, workshop coolant lines and general light chemical transfer. Supplied under the Hoses UK brand.

product.description:

product.name: 4"  camlock cam & groove layflat hose fittings type A, female bsp thread pump connector
product.description:
Camlock Type A fittings are a type of quick-connect coupling commonly used in fluid transfer systems. These fittings consist of a male adaptor with a male thread on one end and a camlock (grooved) connection on the other. The male thread allows the fitting to be connected to a female-threaded pipe or hose, while the camlock connection is designed to quickly and securely connect to a female camlock coupler (Types B, C, D, or DC).

Material: Camlock Type A fittings are typically made from a variety of materials, including aluminum, stainless steel, brass, and polypropylene, depending on the application requirements.

Sizes: These fittings are available in a range of sizes, typically from ½ inch to 6 inches, to accommodate different hose and pipe diameters.

Design Features:

Male Adaptor: One end has a male threaded adaptor, which can be screwed into a female-threaded component.
Grooved End: The opposite end features the camlock design, which includes a groove that allows the female camlock coupler to latch securely onto it using cam arms.
Uses of Camlock Type A Fittings:
Camlock Type A fittings are used in a wide range of industries due to their versatility and ease of use. Here are some common applications:

Fluid Transfer Systems:

Used in the transfer of liquids, including water, chemicals, petroleum products, and fuels, from one container or pipe to another.
Agriculture:

Employed in irrigation systems, pesticide spraying, and transferring liquid fertilizers.
Chemical Processing:

Utilized in industries where chemicals are transferred between tanks, pipes, and machinery.
Food and Beverage Industry:

Used in sanitary applications for transferring liquids like juices, milk, and other food-grade substances, especially when made from stainless steel or other sanitary materials.
Petroleum Industry:

Essential in the transfer of fuels and other petroleum-based liquids, where a secure, leak-proof connection is crucial.

product.name: DekDrain Eezee with PVC Grating B125 Grid Black (1000x131x98mm) Pack of 19
product.description:
Eezee channel has colossal advantages

Featuring 6 cut points, enabling end-to-end interlocking stability on runs with cuts. Easily create a socket/spigot channel with no butted joints at 300 / 400 / 600 / 700 & 800mm lengths. Cutting to 500mm leaves an end butt joint. Cuts between 300 - 500mm and 800 - 1000mm will allow full grating lockdown. 

With Eezee channel you get 12 drain connection points alongside the ability to interlock in 8 directions, creating crosses, tees, and staggered runs without additional fittings. Save money and time. Get the job done faster with fewer components. Polypropolyne is silky smooth for self-cleansing and reduced silt build-up which reduces maintenance costs and cleaning. Relatively lightweight yet strong material provides a robust channel that is less prone to transit or onsite breakages reducing downtime.

Why DekDrain Eezee?
Each 500mm grating is secured by a bolt and locking bar
Easily create a 90-degree tee or elbow with no corner quads
Flexible outlet connections - 12 outlet options to best suit your installation
No additional fittings needed - Eezee saves money
Certified EN1433
Polypropolyne channel

product.name: 48mm 45 Degree Plastic Hose Connector Black Barbed Hose Connector for Garden Hoses, Pond Hoses, Water Pipes

The 45-degree design helps reduce hose stress while maintaining steady water flow, making it particularly useful in spaces where a gentle directional change is required. With its barbed ends, the connector ensures a firm grip on the hose, preventing leaks and slippage even when used under pressure. Perfect for use with garden hoses, pond hoses, aquarium setups, or general water systems, this connector supports efficient water management in both domestic and professional settings. Whether used in irrigation, pond filtration, or household water projects, it helps maintain neat and organised hose routing while protecting hoses from kinking. Made from high-quality T6063 aluminium, each connector is engineered with a polished finish and consistent 1.6mm wall thickness, offering durability and a clean appearance. Available in a wide selection of outer diameters to suit standard hose sizes, these joiners are ideal for linking silicone, rubber, or plastic hoses in coolant systems, air intakes, vacuum lines, and oil or fuel setups. Whether you're building a custom engine bay or upgrading machinery, these connectors ensure a tight, efficient seal with minimal pressure drop. Easy to install, modify, or trim to length, they’re suitable for both professional workshops and home garages. Their compatibility with standard hoses makes them a versatile choice for long-lasting performance in harsh environments, withstanding extreme heat, vibration, and chemical exposure. A high-performance solution for anyone requiring precision connections in demanding systems.

Unlike bulky acrylic trays, it provides a seamless, tile-ready base that integrates beautifully with your bathroom floor. Lightweight but exceptionally strong, the tray includes a pre-formed 2% gradient for efficient drainage and is coated with a cementitious layer, ready for tiling with ceramic, porcelain, stone, or mosaics.  Available in both 20mm and 25mm depths, this versatile tray can be trimmed by up to 50mm from each edge (equal cuts required), giving installers complete flexibility. It comes with a Corner-positioned square drain, with a choice of six grate designs – Leaf, Tile, Square, Sunburst, Spiral or Radial – and three finishes: Black, Gold, or Stainless Steel. The Thermopanel system is suitable for timber or concrete floors, works seamlessly with electric underfloor heating, and is supported by a lifetime warranty when fitted according to manufacturer’s instructions.  Key Features:  20mm or 25mm depth options. Square Corner drain with 6 grate designs (Leaf, Tile, Square, Sunburst, Spiral, Radial). Tile On grate is reversible, allowing for either a tile on or a solid grate design. Choice of finishes: Black, Gold, Stainless Steel. Waste included. Pre-made 2% fall ensures fast water flow. Tile-ready surface, suitable for ceramic, porcelain, mosaics & natural stone. Lightweight, strong, and easy to install. Trim up to 50mm from each edge for flexibility. Compatible with electric underfloor heating. Suitable for timber and concrete floors. Backed by a 25 year warranty.

product.name: Auto Silicone Hoses 19mm ID Black 2 Ply Silicone Radiator Coolant Heater Hose 25 Metres Flexible Water Coolant Pipe
product.description: High-performance black 2-ply silicone radiator, coolant and heater hose with a 19mm internal diameter, supplied as a continuous 25 metres cut length. Constructed from premium smooth-bore silicone rubber reinforced with two plies of woven polyester, this hose delivers outstanding heat resistance, flexibility and service life compared with conventional EPDM rubber coolant hose. It resists ozone, UV, ageing, water, antifreeze and coolant chemicals, remaining flexible and reliable in demanding under-bonnet conditions. Suited to radiator, heater, coolant, header-tank, breather, induction and turbo boost applications across automotive, motorsport, marine, agricultural and industrial builds. Operating range approximately -50C to +180C with short peaks to +200C. IMPORTANT: silicone is intended for water and coolant systems only and must NOT be used for fuel, oil or petroleum products; select a fluorosilicone-lined hose for those duties. Match the bore to your pipe outside diameter and secure with suitable hose clamps.

product.name: 55mm 45 Degree Plastic Hose Connector Blue Barbed Hose Connector for Garden Hoses, Pond Hoses, Water Pipes
product.description: This 45 Degree Plastic Hose Connector is a practical solution for creating smooth, angled connections between hoses. Manufactured from tough, lightweight ABS plastic, it offers excellent durability and resistance to weathering, corrosion, and everyday wear. The 45-degree design helps reduce hose stress while maintaining steady water flow, making it particularly useful in spaces where a gentle directional change is required. With its barbed ends, the connector ensures a firm grip on the hose, preventing leaks and slippage even when used under pressure. Perfect for use with garden hoses, pond hoses, aquarium setups, or general water systems, this connector supports efficient water management in both domestic and professional settings. Quick and easy to install, simply push the hose ends over the barbs to achieve a secure, watertight seal. Whether used in irrigation, pond filtration, or household water projects, it helps maintain neat and organised hose routing while protecting hoses from kinking. Combining reliability, strength, and ease of use, this connector is an essential accessory for gardeners, pond enthusiasts, and DIY users who need a cost-effective and long-lasting way to manage hose connections effectively.
